title: Gas Supply Service Fee and Charge Rounding Schedule — Residential Natural Gas Supply
content:
Every Residential Natural Gas Supply plan bills a flat supplier service fee once per billing cycle, in US dollars to the cent, and states whether that fee is waived for dual-fuel households.

| Plan | Monthly service fee (USD per billing cycle) | Dual-fuel fee waiver |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | 5.95 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Capped Variable 12 | 4.95 | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 | 4.95 | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 | 3.95 | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36 | 0.00 | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 12 | 6.95 | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24 | 4.95 | Yes |

**Dual-fuel fee waiver.** Where the waiver reads "Yes", the monthly service fee is not billed for a cycle in which the same premise has an active Beacon Ridge residential electricity agreement. Where it reads "No", the fee is billed whatever electricity the premise takes.

**Charge rounding.** On all seven plans every computed charge and credit is rounded half up to the cent: a third decimal place of 5 or more raises the cent, below 5 leaves it. For example (hypothetical figures), a computed 12.345 rounds to 12.35 and a computed 12.344 rounds to 12.34.

### Points of reading

- Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36 carries a fee of 0.00, so no service fee is billed on it in any cycle.
- Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable is the only plan without the dual-fuel waiver.
- Three plans share the 4.95 fee: Beacon Ridge Gas Capped Variable 12, Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 and Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24.
